## Current Roles

**DPhil Student in Education**  
Department of Education, University of Oxford | Oxford, United Kingdom

- Doctoral research on inequalities in education, social networks, and students’ trajectories in academically selective and stratified systems.

**Doctoral Teaching Fellow**  
Department of Education, University of Oxford | Oct 2025 – Current

- Co-teaches Introduction to Quantitative Research and Intermediate Quantitative Research in the PhD and MSc in Education programmes.
- Supports postgraduate students in the design and implementation of quantitative research in education.

**Estudiante de Doctorado en Educación (DPhil)**  
Department of Education, University of Oxford | Oxford, Reino Unido

- Investigación doctoral sobre desigualdades educativas, redes sociales y trayectorias estudiantiles en sistemas académicamente selectivos y estratificados.

**Fellow de Docencia Doctoral**  
Department of Education, University of Oxford | Oct 2025 – Actualidad
